blocks.text: Kids ages 8 and up will love building their own bunny toy with posable head, ears and legs with the LEGO Creator Cute Bunny (31162) toy building set. These 3 in 1 toys for girls and boys let them build 3 different LEGO animal figurines with the same building blocks: a posable cute bunny figure with a sunflower and a carrot, a posable llama toy with a patch of green grass and half a carrot, and a seal figure with a fish and a sheet of ice. Get this kids toy as a gift for little ones who love animals or pretend play. LEGO Creator 3 in 1 sets inspire kids’ imaginations with 3 different building options in every box. Build together with friends and family with the LEGO Builder app, which offers a fun and collaborative experience when building this set. Please note that models cannot be built simultaneously. Contains 326 pieces.

items: 3 IN 1 – LEGO Creator Cute Bunny toy for kids lets girls and boys ages 8 years old and older build and rebuild 3 different animal figures using the same bricks
BUILDABLE ANIMAL TOYS – Kids can choose exciting adventures with 3 different nature figurines (models cannot be built simultaneously): a cute bunny toy, a llama toy and a seal toy
POSABLE – The cute bunny toy can move its head, ears, forelegs and hind legs; the llama toy can move its ears, head, tail and feet; and the seal toy can move its head, neck and flippers
ACCESSORIES FOR PLAY & DISPLAY – The cute bunny toy has a sunflower and carrot; the llama toy has a patch of grass and the top of a carrot; and the seal toy has a sheet of ice and a fish
EASTER GIFT IDEA – The 3 in 1 toy provides a fun build-and-play experience for little builders and can be given as a birthday or holiday gift
LEGO CREATOR TOYS – Every 3 in 1 set lets kids build 3 different models inspired by their biggest passions, including animals, vehicles and houses
DIMENSIONS – This 326-piece LEGO set features a buildable cute bunny toy standing over 7.5 in. (19 cm) tall
